title: Unit compatibility for the affine-chart pullback square
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $V\subseteq Y$ and $U\subseteq X$ affine opens with $U\subseteq f^{-1}V$, and $G$ an $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put $A=\mathcal O_Y(V)$, $B=\mathcal O_X(U)$, $\rho=f^\sharp|_U:A\to B$, $\psi=\operatorname{Spec}\rho$, and let $j_V:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$, $j_U:\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ be the canonical charts [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Use the standard pullback/direct-image adjunctions and restriction along open immersions [def-pc-module-pullback], [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. Let $e_V:\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}A,G|_{j_V})\to G(V)$ and $e_U:\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}B,(f^*G)|_{j_U})\to(f^*G)(U)$ be the canonical section identifications, inverse to restriction to the image of the chart. The equality $\psi j_V=j_U f$ gives the right-adjoint isomorphism $\delta:\psi_*j_{V*}\cong j_{U*}f_*$ by pushforward composition. Let $k:j_V^{\mathrm{res}}\psi^*\cong f^*j_U^{\mathrm{res}}$ be the unique left-adjoint comparison obtained by transporting the second composite adjunction through $\delta^{-1}$. Then for every $s\in G(V)$, $$e_U(k_{G,\operatorname{Spec}B}(\eta_\psi(e_V^{-1}s)))=\eta_f(s)|_U.$$ No quasi-coherence assumption is required.

proof.text: Form the two composite adjunctions for restriction along j_V followed by pullback along psi, and pullback along f followed by restriction along j_U. The affine chart square identifies their composite pushforwards, giving delta and hence k.

The unit equation for uniqueness of left adjoints carries the first composite unit to the transported second composite unit. Evaluate this equality on s over V, and restrict its value along psi^{-1}(j_V^{-1}V)=Spec B to the top open.

The units of the restriction adjunctions are section restriction maps. The inverse of e_V is restriction from V to j_V(Spec A). Naturality of the psi unit and of k with respect to the equalities of inverse-image opens turns the left side into e_U(k(eta_psi(e_V^{-1}s))). On the right, delta^{-1}, the restriction unit for j_U, and e_U are restrictions or transports along inclusions of opens. Their composite inclusion is U contained in f^{-1}V, so functoriality of the presheaf gives precisely eta_f(s)|_U.
